findings.evidence: On baseline 3fd4d97c5f4d1a0e7bb5fad8322ab32912691e52, discover(config, [chosen_symlink_directory]) returned lexical plugin paths and load rejected NotADirectoryError, while the same canonical directory loaded successfully. Exact baseline reproduction is /workspace/review-final-trust-skeptical-repro.json.
findings.fix: Resolve only a user-selected extra plugin directory to its real root once during discovery. Existing verified-byte loading and no-follow traversal remain unchanged: final-file symlinks, substituted root symlinks and unsafe writable roots refuse execution; retargeting the selected alias after discovery cannot redirect the pinned path.
findings.design: Resolving each complete plugin filename would incorrectly authorize internal/final symlinks. Resolving only the selected directory reuses the shared trust walker, costs one realpath per explicit directory and adds no recursive scan.
findings.validation: Four exact cases cover successful explicit alias, post-discovery alias retargeting, final-file symlink, substituted canonical-root symlink and writable-root refusal. Existing pinned-byte and unsafe-file assertions remain. 105 passed in 12.20s; 236 passed in 32.85s.
findings.limits: Actual local Git repositories, Git rewrite resolution, plugin discovery/execution and filesystem confinement; no public fetch, live SSH/proxy connection, live successful artifact attestation, multiuser cluster or performance claim. findings.evidence: On baseline 3fd4d97c5f4d1a0e7bb5fad8322ab32912691e52, declared origin https://github.com/rahel99x/Raven.git plus local url.<different-local-origin>.insteadOf caused git remote get-url origin to report the different endpoint, yet verify labeled the channel official-repository. Exact baseline reproduction is /workspace/review-final-trust-skeptical-repro.json.
findings.fix: Check every declared URL and every effective fetch URL from git remote get-url --all under the same bounded Git environment as fetch. Both sets must be exclusively official; otherwise require explicit --allow-fork and classify explicit-fork. The official artifact-attestation policy refuses such a fork. Refusals show declared/effective classifications and recovery commands without exposing endpoint credentials.
findings.design: Inspecting effective Git configuration preserves existing SSH, proxy and credential behavior. Disabling all Git rewrite/transport configuration would break legitimate official HTTPS-to-SSH workflows. There is one additional bounded local Git process per policy check, with no added network request; no timing improvement is claimed.
findings.validation: Actual Git tests accept official scp-style SSH and ssh:// rewrites, refuse an official spelling redirected to a local fork, preserve the explicit fork path and fail closed for official attestation. A real redirected local fetch refuses before checkout/backup mutation, then updates with explicit authorization. Multiple URLs, trailing whitespace, official URL equivalence and credential-free diagnostics are covered. 105 passed in 12.20s; 236 passed in 32.85s.
